name: codecep
description: CoDecep — forensic-grade anti-cheat IDE engine. Monorepo root: this package exists so Heroku can build both workspaces from the repo root and start the single-app server.

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.build:client: npm --prefix codecep-client install && npm --prefix codecep-client run build
scripts.build:server: npm --prefix codecep-server install --legacy-peer-deps && npm --prefix codecep-server run build
